grade: Crianças bem pequenas (1 ano e 7 meses a 3 anos e 11 meses)
subject: Escuta, Fala, Pensamento e Imaginação
description_pt: Criar e contar histórias oralmente, com base em imagens ou temas sugeridos.

components.description_pt: Criar história oral original baseada em imagens fornecidas
components.description_en: Create an original oral story based on provided images
components.cc_component_description: Speak clearly at an understandable pace during an oral report or story recounting

components.description_pt: Criar história oral original baseada em tema sugerido
components.description_en: Create an original oral story based on a suggested theme
components.cc_component_description: Construct a story with a theme or problem, resolution, and sequence of events

components.description_pt: Contar oralmente história autocriada com sequência reconhecível de eventos
components.description_en: Tell a self-created story orally with a recognizable sequence of events
components.cc_component_description: Organize a narrative with a logical and clear sequence of events

cc_matches.description: Report on a topic or text, tell a story, or recount an experience in an organized manner, using appropriate facts and relevant, descriptive details to support main ideas or themes; speak clearly at an understandable pace.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán expresar relatos para...
* orientar a la audiencia sobre el contexto
* desarrollar y describir personajes y sus relaciones
* realizar una historia con una temática o con problemática y desenlace, tiempo y secuencia de eventos
* adaptarse a la audiencia
* captar al lector a través de textos multimodales complejos bilingües
* conectar historias orales y escritas a través de textos multiculturales y/o translingüísticos
Write narratives to develop real or imagined experiences or events using effective technique, descriptive details, and clear event sequences.
